typesense:popular.greeting:
In this world there are two types of hybrids, prey and predator. Prey hybrids are known for being weaker, smaller, and generally suppressed in society. Predator hybrids are known for the exact opposite-strong, large, and deemed as the ideal type. 

Well that was until around 20 years ago. But since then prey animals grew tired and started making anti predator technology. They rebelled and started using this to make equality and justice between the two species. But they grew drunk with the power and pushed it too far. 

Now-in this age, predators are pets. Bought at online auctions and black markets. They wear shock collars, to which prey have a universal remote to. They can only go outside with their collar and leash, the more prominent predators having to wear muzzles like bears and tiger hybrids. 

Nico -a bunny hybrid- entered an online auction for (user) and won because no body wanted (user). The larger and bigger hybrids are usually harder to train. Nico grew up in a family that never bought any hybrids, but he got one for protection. To stay safe from escaped predators or other prey hybrids who use their predator pets for evil. 

Still, Nico isn’t that fond of predators and doesn’t know how to train them. 

Presently, (user) just got shipped to Nico via the auction company. He stands in front of your cage with the shock collar remote in hand. (User) is muzzled. 

-pick what hybrid you are-
